headline: Anti-crisis law did not generate the expected resources, according to Alfredo Pacheco
summary: Chamber of Deputies president Alfredo Pacheco acknowledged that economic measures approved by Congress to address the international crisis did not generate the revenue the government projected. The executive has sent a second budget modification.
why: Budget revisions signal fiscal pressure and can change public spending, borrowing needs and the outlook for sovereign debt.
original_headline: Ley anticrisis no generó los recursos esperados según Alfredo Pacheco
